The Chinese characters for Emma

As a transliteration, Emma is usually written 艾玛 (Ài mǎ). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Ài

玛

Origin and meaning

From Germanic, Emma carries the meaning “whole, universal”.

About the name Emma

Jane Austen's novel Emma (1815) made the name a literary favourite.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “whole, universal”, an Emma calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
